triggers.name: agent_sessions_immutable_binding
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dream_guard_agent_sessions_immutable_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.agent_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.agent_session_id
    OR OLD.workflow_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workflow_run_id
    OR OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id
    OR OLD.runtime_environment_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_environment_id
    OR OLD.runtime_pool_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_pool_id
    OR OLD.distribution_mode IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.distribution_mode
    OR OLD.runtime_node_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_node_id
    OR OLD.artifact_set_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.artifact_set_hash
    OR OLD.policy_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_revision
    OR OLD.deployment_tier IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deployment_tier
    OR OLD.runtime_plugin_lock_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_plugin_lock_id
    OR OLD.runtime_plugin_lock_digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_plugin_lock_digest
    OR OLD.settings_json IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settings_json
    OR OLD.settings_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.settings_hash
    OR OLD.plugin_set_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.plugin_set_hash
    OR OLD.session_request_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.session_request_key
    OR OLD.attempt_number IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.attempt_number
    OR OLD.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000', MESSAGE = 'agent session binding is immutable';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

    OR OLD.runtime_pool_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_pool_id

    OR OLD.claude_code_plugin_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.claude_code_plugin_id

    OR OLD.artifact_digest IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.artifact_digest
    OR OLD.artifact_set_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.artifact_set_hash
    OR OLD.policy_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.policy_revision
    OR OLD.materialization_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.materialization_key
    OR OLD.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000', MESSAGE = 'runtime materialization identity is immutable';

triggers.name: users_sync_billing_identity
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_canonical_user_billing_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  billing_identity_id text;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO platform_users (
    id, source, external_user_id, email, display_name, tier, status, metadata
  ) VALUES (
    'usr_' || md5('ink-dream:' || NEW.id::text),
    'ink-dream',
    NEW.id::text,
    NEW.email,
    NEW.display_name,
    'free',
    'active',
    jsonb_build_object('managedBy', 'canonical-users')
  )
  ON CONFLICT (source, external_user_id) DO UPDATE
  SET email = EXCLUDED.email,
      display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name,
      updated_at = NOW()
  RETURNING id INTO billing_identity_id;

  INSERT INTO billing_accounts (id, platform_user_id)
  VALUES (
    'acct_' || md5('canonical-user:' || billing_identity_id),
    billing_identity_id
  )
  ON CONFLICT (platform_user_id) DO NOTHING;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER users_sync_billing_identity AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF email, display_name ON users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION sync_canonical_user_billing_identity()

triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dream_guard_workflow_runs_immutable_provenance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF OLD.id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id
    OR OLD.workspace_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workspace_id
    OR OLD.deck_plugin_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deck_plugin_id
    OR OLD.deck_plugin_version IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deck_plugin_version
    OR OLD.workflow_definition_ref IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workflow_definition_ref
    OR OLD.deck_runtime_snapshot_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deck_runtime_snapshot_id
    OR OLD.retry_of_run_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.retry_of_run_id
    OR OLD.deck_plugin_manifest_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deck_plugin_manifest_hash
    OR OLD.deck_plugin_binding_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.deck_plugin_binding_id
    OR OLD.binding_revision IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.binding_revision
    OR OLD.runtime_plugin_lock_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_plugin_lock_id
    OR OLD.workflow_preflight_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.workflow_preflight_id
    OR OLD.source_voice_thread_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.source_voice_thread_id
    OR OLD.idempotency_key IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.idempotency_key
    OR OLD.input_hash IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.input_hash
    OR OLD.semantic_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.semantic_fingerprint
    OR OLD.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_by
    OR OLD.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at
    OR (
    OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id
    AND NOT (
    OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NULL
    AND NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
    AND OLD.status = 'queued'
    AND NEW.status = 'running'
    )
    ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '55000', MESSAGE = 'workflow run provenance is immutable';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER workflow_runs_immutable_provenance BEFORE UPDATE ON workflow_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION dream_guard_workflow_runs_immutable_provenance()

triggers.name: workflow_runs_joint_session_binding_guard
triggers.function:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dream_guard_workflow_runs_joint_session_binding_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NULL) != (NEW.agent_session_id IS NULL)
    OR (
      OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NULL
      AND OLD.agent_session_id IS NULL
      AND NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT (OLD.status = 'queued' AND NEW.status = 'running')
    )
    OR (
      OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        OLD.runtime_load_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id
        OR OLD.agent_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.agent_session_id
      )
    )
    OR (
      NEW.status IN (
        'running', 'output_validating', 'pending_review', 'confirmed',
        'rejected', 'completed'
      )
      AND NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NULL
    )
    OR (
      NEW.status IN ('preflight', 'queued')
      AND NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id IS NOT NULL
    )
    OR (
      NEW.agent_session_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        NEW.agent_session_id = NEW.source_voice_thread_id
        OR NEW.agent_session_id = NEW.source_message_id
      )
    )
    OR (
      NEW.agent_session_id IS NOT NULL
      AND OLD.agent_session_id IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM agent_sessions AS session
        WHERE session.agent_session_id = NEW.agent_session_id
          AND session.workflow_run_id = NEW.id
          AND session.runtime_load_receipt_id = NEW.runtime_load_receipt_id
          AND session.runtime_plugin_lock_id = NEW.runtime_plugin_lock_id
          AND session.status = 'active'
      )
    ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '55000',
      MESSAGE = 'workflow run receipt and session binding is invalid';
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER workflow_runs_joint_session_binding_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON workflow_runs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION dream_guard_workflow_runs_joint_session_binding_guard()
